'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Typhoon Rai]]
**The death toll in the [[Philippines]] from Typhoon Rai increases to 375. At least 500 more people are injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59714658 (BBC News)]
*[[2021 Semeru eruption]]
**The [[Semeru]] [[volcano]] in [[Java]], [[Indonesia]], erupts for the second time this month, spewing a two-kilometre-high ash column. The first eruption killed at least 46 people on December 4. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesias-semeru-volcano-erupts-people-warned-stay-away-2021-12-19/ (Reuters)]
*A light plane crashes off [[Australia]]'s east coast of [[Queensland]], killing all four people on board, including two children. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2021/dec/19/light-plane-crashes-into-water-near-brisbane (''The Guardian'')]
*A "tornado-like" severe weather event impacts [[Sydney]]'s [[Northern Beaches]] on Australia's east coast, downing trees and cutting power to thousands of residents. One woman is killed and two women are in a critical condition in Sydney's Royal North Shore Hospital after a "large" pine tree fell in [[Narrabeen]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-12-19/one-dead-two-injured-after-sydney-storm-northern-beaches/100712606/ (ABC News)]
*A child dies in hospital three days after an [[inflatable castle]] was lifted into the air in [[Devonport, Tasmania]], Australia, bringing the death toll from the accident to six. [https://www.news.com.au/national/sixth-child-dead-in-tasmania-jumping-castle-tragedy/video/319d34bd7399be27fd817e2fd8ad43e7 (News.com.au)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a person who travelled from the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.jpost.com/health-and-wellness/coronavirus/iran-reports-its-first-case-of-omicron-coronavirus-variant-689163 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] announces that it will require a proof of [[Vaccine passports during the COVID-19 pandemic|COVID-19 vaccination certificate]] for entry into public places beginning on January 1 in an attempt to reduce the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://apnews.com/article/coronavirus-pandemic-health-sri-lanka-5372e7846878fad91e5712cec7f49362 (Associated Press)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****The [[Netherlands]] imposes strict [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] measures that restrict visitors to two people, closes all non-essential shops, bars, and restaurants until January 14, and closes schools until January 9, due to an increase in COVID-19 cases caused by the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/europe/586428-netherlands-imposes-weeks-long-nationwide-lockdown-amid-omicron (''The Hill'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] introduces an 8:00 p.m. closure time for bars and restaurants, restricts the capacity of most indoor and outdoor events to 50%, and allows a maximum of 100 guests for weddings in order to reduce the spread of the Omicron variant. [https://medicalxpress.com/news/2021-12-ireland-pm-curfew-hospitality.html (Medical Xpress)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Peru]]
***[[Peru]] reports its first four cases of the Omicron variant in one person who travelled from [[South Africa]] and another three who had no travel history. [https://www.reuters.com/article/amp/idINL1N2T40GW (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Chilean general election]]
**[[Chileans]] go to the polls to elect their [[President of Chile|president]] in a run-off between [[leftist]] [[Gabriel Boric]] and [[right-wing]] candidate [[José Antonio Kast]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/12/19/us-chile-election-voters (Euronews)]
**With over 50% of votes counted, Boric is declared the winner as Kast publishes a tweet conceding defeat. [https://amp.cnn.com/cnn/2021/12/19/americas/chile-election-gabriel-boric-intl-nk/index.html?fbclid=IwAR1MQoyZV9Jva8vkdc2nfQyySVFyEMphbpq3cJizaNZKzLLaLc6H7b2jA8g (CNN)]
*[[2019–2021 Sudanese protests]]
**Tens of thousands of protesters demonstrate against the [[October 2021 Sudanese coup d'état]], leading to government forces spraying protesters with [[tear gas]] in an attempt to halt the demonstrations, one of the largest in Sudan's history. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/world/sudan-coup-anniversary-protests-1.6292147 (CBC News)]
*A man in India is beaten to death by guards at the [[Golden Temple]], the holiest place in the world according to the [[Sikhism|Sikh religion]]. Authorities allege he may have tried to harm the [[Guru Granth Sahib]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59715937 (BBC News)]
